title: Eastern Front 1941–1945 / 東部戦線3Dアニメーション
model: Manual generalized frontline polylines interpreted from West Point campaign maps. Continuous interpolation between key dates. Not daily unit positions.
geometry: Published Natural Earth coastline / rivers, Mercator projection. Extruded board with 3D unit meshes and attack curves; no terrain elevation model.
omissions: Detailed Crimea and other separate fronts
Exact pocket dimensions and daily territorial control

validation.video: PASS: 12 representative source frames visually inspected; encoded 1942-11-23 frame inspected. H.264 1440x870, 24 fps, 124 seconds, 2976 decoded frames, all 2976 unique, continuous timestamps. No decoder errors.
validation.interactive: JavaScript scene construction, dates, event transitions and finite transforms validated in a Node simulation. Full browser rendering/interaction was not tested because local-file navigation was blocked.
